You must apply before 31 March 2027. You must not apply more than once.

The dose is 0.5 mg taken twice daily. Do not exceed 2.5 mg in any 24-hour
period. A dose of 5 mg may cause serious harm.

Version 1.5.0 is affected by this issue. Version 1.5.1 is unaffected.

The fee is £1,250.00 plus VAT at 20%, payable to Account 12345678, sort code
20-00-00. Payments received after 17:00 GMT are treated as next-day.

Full guidance is at https://www.gov.uk/example-guidance/apply-online and
enquiries should go to casework.team@example.gov.uk.

Applicants shall provide evidence of residence. Applicants may provide a utility
bill. Applicants shall not provide originals.

The configuration file is at C:\ProgramData\Example\config.ini on Windows and
/etc/example/config.ini on Linux.
